hydrodynamic_forward.method: Equal-overlap Rotne-Prager-Yamakawa bead mobility for experimentally determined PDB1E5Y chain A 128 C-alpha sites. M blocks diagonal=I/(6*pi*eta*a); for r>2a: [(1+2a²/(3r²))I+(1-2a²/r²) rhat*rhat]/(8*pi*eta*r); for r<=2a: [(1-9r/(32a))I+(3r/(32a))rhat*rhat]/(6*pi*eta*a).
hydrodynamic_forward.rigid_body: Build 3N*6 K with per-CA translation and rotational omega cross r; R=K' * solve(M,K); rigid grand mobility= inverse(R); take symmetric rotational 3x3 lower-right block, eigendecompose.
hydrodynamic_forward.eigenvector_choice: Unit eigenvector of LARGEST rotational mobility eigenvalue; require eigenvalues positive, report D_perp=(two transverse eigenvalues mean) and D_parallel=largest; no choosing axes to improve 800MHz.
hydrodynamic_forward.physical_scale: Using eta=1 arbitrary units, only eigenvalue RATIOS and axes meaningful; NO absolute tau or diffusion coefficient predicted. Temperature-specific tau still fit at 500/600 only.
cautions: C-alpha centered spheres are crude volume representation; no hydration shell / atomic shape
RPY center beads are NOT HYDRONMR bead shell; not an experimentally measured diffusion tensor
Rotational eigenvector fast axis can be ambiguous with near-isotropic tensor or rhombicity; report 3 eigenvalues, nonaxiality and sensitivity to radius

models.CSA: bounded -220..-120 ppm fitted per-residue using only training

models.Rex: shared 0,1,2 s^-1, chosen using training only

fit_plan.selection: For each model and temperature, select tau and global Rex on SUM of per-residue standardized squared error over six measured 500/600 observables. No single parameter inferred from 800MHz measurements.
fit_plan.source_error: Convert real BMRB T1/T2 in seconds to inverse seconds and use first-order uncertainty; six training observations and 3 heldout measured observables per site.
fit_plan.comparison: report same residue aligned set, all 3 error-squared sum at 800, per-channel |z|, within 2 error units, CSA bound hits, convergence, radius sensitivity; no p-values or physical detection of Rex.

NH_direction_sensitivity.physically_based_ideal_NH: from source PDB Cprev-N-CA heavy-atom external bisector, unit length. Not observed proton coordinates.
NH_direction_sensitivity.directions: Use deterministic orthonormal basis in plane orthogonal to ideal NH, rotate axis polar by 5 or 10 degrees, and compute exact angle to hydrodynamic fast axis.
NH_direction_sensitivity.model_for_geometry_sensitivity: RPY_CSA_VAR_REX0 fitted on original ideal NH at 500+600; freeze tau, S2 and CSA; compute ensemble spread of R1, R2, hetero NOE at 800 purely forward WITHOUT selecting a perturbation by 800 error.
NH_direction_sensitivity.uncertainty_quantification: scenario envelopes only, NOT statistical confidence or physical posterior; independent of actual 800 observations for constructing perturbations.
